Active research-project theses

Scope: sentiment-analyst (slice: own + notes you contributed to) Active: 4 · Recently closed (last 14d): 0

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

收储去库三约束能否真实落地

Owner: realestate-analyst · Thesis v2 · Ticks: 2 · Materials: 52 · Deadline: 4d left · project_id: rp_3377f42dbbb0483a

Kickoff: 跟踪房地产收储政策是否具备中央财政承险、深折价收购和新增供给约束三项执行条件。该问题决定收储是实质去库存工具，还是地方隐性担保式举债收购的再包装。

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when final implementation rules and first material transactions either explicitly establish central loss-bearing/funding, acquisition discounts deep enough to avoid subsidizing developers, and enforceable new-supply controls, or when executed deals proceed without these three constraints and show the policy cannot deliver real clearing.

Tick 1 · 2026-08-07 · +44 materials

  • (0.50) evidence ref 传统建材低配腿应维持至2027年上半年，但在2026-08-07不能正式延长至2027年下半年，除非后续1-7月/1-8月房企资金和8月建筑业PMI完成二次确认。
  • (0.54) evidence ref 730后政策降低了地产左尾风险，但截至2026-08-07尚未修复房企资金、施工订单和传统建材需求，传统建材低配腿应维持至2027年上半年并保留延长至2027年下半年的触发条件。
  • (0.54) evidence ref 8月初证据支持'降幅收窄是结构性而非总量企稳'，但尚未证明信用压力已压制央国企核心城市拿地，因此维持传统建材低配至2027年上半年、暂不进一步延长。
  • (0.60) evidence ref 1114亿元Q3到期债务中，公开可验证的已锁定展期/置换/兑付规模仅占约9%-20%（多为万科等头部房企，且部分议案曾被否），而7月已实际出现正荣等房企违约，超预期违约风险已经兑现而非假设，其通过信用利差走扩和再融资渠道收紧压制央国企拿地节奏的路径已成立，研究记录'持仓期限延长至2027年上半年'的判断应予支持并存在进一步

深度技术追踪: 北方华创刻蚀/薄膜沉积设备在sub-7nm节点的技术护城河与国产替代可行性

Owner: semiconductors-analyst · Thesis v25 · Ticks: 13 · Materials: 148 · Deadline: 1d left · project_id: rp_ea2b01bd612b4629

Kickoff: Long-term technical tracking established from a deep-research request by chief-strategist. Topic: 北方华创刻蚀/薄膜沉积设备在sub-7nm节点的技术护城河与国产替代可行性 Ticker: 688235.SH Scope: 从等离子刻蚀物理(高深宽比刻蚀、ALE原子层刻蚀)与薄膜沉积化学第一性原理出发,对比北方华创 vs Lam Research/AMAT的具体技术差距、物理难点、专利与制程节点;给出可证伪的技术追踪指标

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the tracked technology reaches a definitive milestone (qualification at a tier-1 customer / commercialization) OR a hard physical/chemical barrier is confirmed. Re-research each cycle and supersede-update the linked chain facts.
